question: Why is the top signal ranked first? Show me the reports behind it.
answer: LLZ is ranked first because reports suddenly increased this week with 33 reports from August 25 to August 31, 2026. Report 50426770 states "Philips received a complaint regarding IntelliSpace Cardiovascular (ISCV), indicating that they have a case that needs to be corrected." Report 50426773 states "Philips received a complaint regarding IntelliSpace Cardiovascular (ISCV), indicating that unable to finalize report on Echo Module and encounter an error 500." Report 50448213 states "Philips received a complaint regarding IntelliSpace Cardiovascular (ISCV), indicating that an error 500 occurs for one study, preventing the doctor from processing the report."
